contexts.text: A grove, or plantation, = the things which are of the rational things which are adjoined to doctrine and its Knowledges; for trees in general = perceptions; but, when predicated of the Spiritual Church, they = Knowledges...
All the small trees = scientifics; but the greater plantations = Knowledges and perceptions.
Around those who are in truths, which are not from good... plantations sometimes appear; but unlovely and barren.
The inhabitants of (the Third) Earth love plantations of trees, and an edifice from them... for trees and wood = goods.
